context: Aoi and Riku talk about a concert performance.
purpose: Casual register; vocabulary (ステージ/公演/楽器/ヒット/キャラ) in natural home.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 昨日の公演、ステージが派手だったよ!
lines.en: Yesterday's show — the stage was flashy!
lines.style: excited teen boy voice, bright warm eager delivery throughout

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: いいね、どんな楽器を使ってたの?
lines.en: Nice, what instruments did they use?
lines.style: bright barista voice, soft warm cheerful delivery throughout

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 珍しい楽器が、たくさんあったよ。
lines.en: There were lots of unusual instruments.
lines.style: enthusiastic teen boy voice, bright warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: ヒット曲も、演奏したの?
lines.en: Did they play their hit songs too?
lines.style: engaged barista voice, soft warm cheerful delivery throughout

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: うん、ヒット曲でステージが盛り上がった。
lines.en: Yeah, the hits got the stage hyped.
lines.style: thrilled teen boy voice, bright warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: メンバーの、キャラも立ってた?
lines.en: Did the members' characters stand out?
lines.style: curious barista voice, soft warm cheerful delivery throughout

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: みんなキャラが濃くて、面白かったよ。
lines.en: Everyone had strong personalities; it was fun.
lines.style: cheerful teen boy voice, bright warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 次の公演、私も行きたいなー!
lines.en: I want to go to the next show too!
lines.style: bubbly barista voice, soft warm cheerful closing delivery throughout
